## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint` and `npm test` pass at the repo root, and `npm run build` in `web/` / pasan el lint, los tests y el build
- [ ] READMEs updated if behaviour changed (`README.md` and `README.es.md`) / READMEs actualizados si cambia el comportamiento
- [ ] No real personal data in code, tests or screenshots (receipts, names, tokens) / Sin datos personales reales
- [ ] New dependencies (if any) are pinned and justified below / Dependencias nuevas fijadas y justificadas
